title: CLI: dynamic short-ID formatter core and short_id_length config (Rust + Python)
description: Rewrite format_issue_key (rust/src/ids.rs, python/src/kanbus/ids.py) to a list formatter: default 4-char lowercase hash prefix, widen colliding groups iteratively (no cap) for uniqueness in the rendered set, uniqueness checked project-wide per project key (shared + local). Add short_id_length config (default 4) to ProjectConfiguration; beads_compatibility implies 6 unless set. Dotted sub-IDs keep suffix.
